summary: Retest of iteration_14's single failing bug (brute-force lockout) plus quick regression. Fix applied in server.py L848 - identifier now uses _client_ip(request) instead of request.client.host. Verified end-to-end: 5x 401 then 429 on 6th and 7th attempt against the preview URL using a throwaway email. Admin login still succeeds afterward. Guest register/login/me/logout regression passes. Contact inquiry form submits successfully from the UI (POST /api/inquiries -> 201, 'Thanks' confirmation shown).
verifications_passed: Brute-force lockout: wrong-password sequence for throwaway bf2_* email returned [401,401,401,401,401,429,429] - lockout triggers on the 6th attempt as expected (previously all stayed 401 due to rotating ingress hop IP)

Admin login (admin@bdsmarvel.com) succeeds with 200 and role=admin immediately after the throwaway brute-force run - admin account is NOT impacted by the throwaway lockout (per-identifier is {ip}:{email})
Guest register -> /auth/me via cookie -> /auth/status -> logout -> re-login all pass (test_register_login_me_logout green)
Contact inquiry form (/contact -> Get in Touch modal) submits successfully: POST /api/inquiries -> 201, UI shows 'Thanks - we've got it.' confirmation
pytest subset: 6/6 passed (TestAdminCreds, TestGuestAuth, TestLoginBruteForce) in 3.98s
critical_code_review_comments: Fix at server.py L848 is correct and minimal (identifier = f"{_client_ip(request)}:{email}")

Still open from iter14 (non-blocking, FYI): server.py is 1185 lines - consider splitting into routers; login_attempts rows are not cleaned when lockout window expires - a TTL index on locked_until or a background sweeper would prevent unbounded growth; in-memory rate_limit buckets don't survive restart or multiple replicas
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_* inquiry rows and one throwaway guest user (bf2_*). Deleted 13 throwaway login_attempts rows post-test to leave the brute-force counter clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Security audit is now fully green (iteration_14's 24 + this iteration's brute-force fix = 25/25). The regression file is /app/backend/tests/test_security_audit.py; the only test that permanently consumes a per-IP bucket is TestRateLimitsLast (public inquiries 5/hr) - restart backend before re-running to reset in-memory rate buckets.
rca of the issue: iteration_14 RCA stands: request.client.host returns the Kubernetes ingress hop IP which rotates between pod IPs, so the per-identifier login_attempts counter was split across multiple keys and never reached 5. Fix in server.py L848 switches to _client_ip(request) which reads the first hop of X-Forwarded-For, producing a stable per-real-client identifier. Reproduction (post-fix): 6 wrong-password POSTs to /api/auth/login for the same throwaway email -> the 6th and 7th now return 429 as expected.
